# WebOctals

> WebOctals is a UK studio building websites, AI agents and automation for small businesses. We work mostly with local trades and service businesses — driving schools, takeaways, barbers, taxi firms, trade suppliers — and with teams who have outgrown off-the-shelf software.

Websites are priced by page count: £1,000 up to five pages, £1,500 up to ten, £2,000+ for twenty or more. Work that isn't measured in pages — AI agents, automation, machine learning, changes to an existing site — is quoted at £50 per hour. All of it is negotiable and fixed in writing before work starts. You speak directly to the engineer building it; the whole build stays in-house.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://weboctals.com/pricing/): Published rates, what counts as a page, and what moves a quote up or down.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://weboctals.com/services/): Every service, grouped by how deep into a business it goes.
- [Web Development](https://weboctals.com/web-development/): Custom and platform-built websites for UK businesses.
- [Digital Products](https://weboctals.com/digital-products/): Booking flows, ordering systems and customer portals.
- [AI Agents](https://weboctals.com/ai-agents/): Agents that handle repetitive enquiries and hand over cleanly to a person.
- [Automation](https://weboctals.com/automation/): Pipelines that remove repetitive manual work and connect systems that were never designed to talk.
- [Machine Learning](https://weboctals.com/machine-learning/): Custom models where there is a real pattern worth catching.
- [Product Development](https://weboctals.com/product-development/): Custom software for teams who have outgrown off-the-shelf tools.
- [SEO](https://weboctals.com/seo/): On-page and technical SEO. No ranking guarantees, on principle.

## Trades we build for

- [Driving schools](https://weboctals.com/driving-schools/): Filling weekday gaps and being found in every town a school teaches in.
- [Takeaways](https://weboctals.com/takeaways/): Menu-first sites with online ordering, without commission on every ticket.
- [Barbers and salons](https://weboctals.com/barbers/): Services and pricing answered immediately, on a phone.
- [Taxi firms](https://weboctals.com/taxi-firms/): Booking and phone contact throughout, structured for local search.
- [Trade suppliers](https://weboctals.com/trade-suppliers/): Capability, coverage and a quote route, answered without scrolling.

## Areas

WebOctals works remotely across the UK from England — there is no office in any of the cities below and the pages say so.

Manchester and Leeds are the two areas we are actively growing into.

- [Manchester](https://weboctals.com/web-development/manchester/): Greater Manchester's ten boroughs, served remotely. No local client yet.
- [Leeds](https://weboctals.com/web-development/leeds/): Leeds district and West Yorkshire, served remotely. No local client yet.
- [London](https://weboctals.com/web-development/london/): Colindale Driving School and A.R Worldwide (Harrow) are London-area builds.
- [Birmingham](https://weboctals.com/web-development/birmingham/): Lumenlux, Quick Fit Shelving (Wednesbury) and Ariana Kitchens are West Midlands builds.
- [Edinburgh](https://weboctals.com/web-development/edinburgh/): Served remotely across Scotland; no local client yet.

## Notes

- Google Search does not read this file; it is here for other agents and assistants that do.
- The homepage contact form (`submit_contact_request`) and blog newsletter forms (`subscribe_to_newsletter`) are exposed as WebMCP tools via declarative `toolname`/`tooldescription` annotations, so a supporting agent can fill and submit them on behalf of a visitor.
